name: Upload Custom Origin Trust Store
description: Upload Custom Origin Trust Store Upload a root CA certificate to the Custom Origin Trust Store for a Zone. POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/acm/custom_trust_store
context:
POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/acm/custom_trust_store
Upload a root CA certificate to the Custom Origin Trust Store for a Zone. Only root CA certificates are accepted.
Required: zone_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete Custom Origin Trust Store
description: Delete Custom Origin Trust Store Removes a root CA certificate from the custom origin trust store. DELETE /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/acm/custom_trust_store/{custom_origin_trust_store_id}

name: Custom Origin Trust Store Details
description: Custom Origin Trust Store Details Retrieves details about a specific root CA certificate in the custom origin trust store, including expiration and subject information. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/acm/custom_trust_store/{custom_origin_trust_store_id}

name: List Custom Origin Trust Store Details
description: List Custom Origin Trust Store Details Get Custom Origin Trust Store for a Zone. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/acm/custom_trust_store
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/acm/custom_trust_store
Get Custom Origin Trust Store for a Zone.
Required: zone_id (path)
Optional: page (query); per_page (query); limit (query); offset (query)

name: Enable or Disable Total TLS
description: Enable or Disable Total TLS Set Total TLS Settings or disable the feature for a Zone. POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/acm/total_tls
context:
POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/acm/total_tls
Set Total TLS Settings or disable the feature for a Zone.
Required: zone_id (path); body (body)

name: Total TLS Settings Details
description: Total TLS Settings Details Get Total TLS Settings for a Zone. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/acm/total_tls
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/acm/total_tls
Get Total TLS Settings for a Zone.
Required: zone_id (path)
